During winter (November to March ), the Sundarbans—the world's largest mangrove forest—transforms into an ideal destination, offering cool, pleasant, and dry weather that provides the best visibility for wildlife spotting. This is the prime season for enthusiasts, as the clear skies and lower tidal levels increase the chances of sighting the majestic Royal Bengal Tiger and saltwater crocodiles, along with numerous migratory birds thriving in this UNESCO World Heritage Site, promising comfortable jungle safaris and an unforgettable experience of its raw, mysterious beauty.
